title: Exercise Catalog Batch 4 — Mobility, Recovery, Conditioning, and Athletic Expansion

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.coachingNote: Move slowly between flexion and extension without forcing either end range.

exercises.name: Child's-pose lat stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Sit the hips back and reach the hands forward while breathing into the upper back.

exercises.name: Thread-the-needle rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Slide one arm under the body and rotate only through a comfortable upper-back range.

exercises.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips steady and rotate the upper back without forcing the neck.

exercises.name: Bench thoracic extension
exercises.coachingNote: Rest the elbows on the bench and sink the chest gently while keeping the ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the ribs down and slide the arms upward only as far as you can maintain wall contact.

exercises.name: Foam-roller wall slide
exercises.coachingNote: Press lightly into the roller and slide upward without shrugging.

exercises.name: Band shoulder pass-through
exercises.coachingNote: Use a wide grip and move the band overhead only through a smooth pain-free range.

exercises.name: Scapular wall clock
exercises.coachingNote: Keep light band tension and move one hand around the clock without shrugging.

exercises.name: Serratus wall slide
exercises.coachingNote: Press gently into the roller and slide upward while keeping the shoulder blades controlled.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Place the forearm on the doorway and turn away gently without forcing the shoulder.

exercises.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Draw the arm across the chest and keep the shoulder relaxed.

exercises.name: Side-lying sleeper stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Lie on the side with the shoulder supported and apply only gentle pressure.

exercises.name: Quadruped wrist extension rock
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the palms down and rock back only through a comfortable wrist range.

exercises.name: Quadruped wrist flexion rock
exercises.coachingNote: Place the backs of the hands down gently and shift only as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Gentle neck rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Turn the head slowly without lifting the chin or pushing into discomfort.

exercises.name: Gentle neck side bend
exercises.coachingNote: Bring one ear toward the shoulder slowly while keeping both shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: 90/90 supine breathing
exercises.coachingNote: Rest the feet on a bench, exhale fully, and breathe quietly into the sides and back of the ribs.

exercises.name: Crocodile breathing
exercises.coachingNote: Lie face-down and breathe gently into the abdomen and lower ribs.

exercises.name: Supported deep-squat breathing
exercises.coachingNote: Hold stable support, sit into a comfortable squat, and breathe without forcing depth.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
exercises.coachingNote: Move between both hip positions slowly and use the hands for support if needed.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip forward fold
exercises.coachingNote: Hinge forward over the front shin while keeping the spine long.

exercises.name: Shin-box get-up
exercises.coachingNote: Move from the shin-box position to standing with control and use support if needed.

exercises.name: Quadruped adductor rock-back
exercises.coachingNote: Extend one leg to the side and rock the hips back without rounding the low back.

exercises.name: Frog stretch rock-back
exercises.coachingNote: Set the knees wide on padding and rock back only through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling adductor mobilization
exercises.coachingNote: Extend one leg to the side and shift the hips back while keeping the foot planted.

exercises.name: Supported pigeon stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Use a bench or high surface and settle into the hip only as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Supine figure-four stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and draw the legs toward you gently.

exercises.name: Supine hamstring floss
exercises.coachingNote: Support the thigh and slowly straighten and bend the knee without forcing a stretch.

exercises.name: Active straight-leg raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the opposite leg long and lift the working leg without the pelvis rolling.

exercises.name: Standing hamstring sweep
exercises.coachingNote: Place one heel forward and sweep the hands toward the foot while hinging gently.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Step into a long lunge, place the hand down, and rotate through the upper back.

exercises.name: Dynamic half-kneeling hip-flexor rock
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the pelvis gently tucked and rock forward without arching the low back.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Support the rear foot on a bench and keep the torso tall without forcing the knee.

exercises.name: Standing quadriceps stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Hold support, draw the heel toward the glute, and keep the knees close.

exercises.name: Straight-knee calf stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the rear knee straight and heel down while leaning toward the wall.

exercises.name: Bent-knee soleus stretch
exercises.coachingNote: Bend the rear knee while keeping the heel down and move forward gently.

exercises.name: Ankle inversion and eversion control
exercises.coachingNote: Move the foot inward and outward slowly without moving the knee.

exercises.name: Controlled ankle circles
exercises.coachingNote: Draw slow circles through the largest comfortable range without moving the leg.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.coachingNote: Alternate lifting the big toe and the smaller toes while keeping the foot relaxed.

exercises.name: Standing band external rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbow by the side and rotate the forearm outward without moving the upper arm.

exercises.name: Side-lying dumbbell external rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbow against the torso and rotate slowly through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Standing band internal rotation
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arm still and rotate the forearm inward without twisting the torso.

exercises.name: Scapular push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbows straight and let the shoulder blades move around the rib cage.

exercises.name: Quadruped scapular push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbows straight and move the chest gently between and away from the floor.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the ribs down and pull the band apart without shrugging.

exercises.name: Band no-money drill
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbows at the sides and rotate the hands outward without arching the back.

exercises.name: Supine serratus punch
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbow straight and reach the shoulder blade upward without lifting the head.

exercises.name: Prone T-raise
exercises.coachingNote: Raise the arms out to the sides with the thumbs up and keep the neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Prone W-raise
exercises.coachingNote: Bend the elbows into a W and lift the arms without shrugging.

exercises.name: Band terminal knee extension
exercises.coachingNote: Anchor the band behind the knee and straighten the leg fully without shifting the hips.

exercises.name: Short-arc quadriceps extension
exercises.coachingNote: Support the knee over a bolster and straighten the leg without lifting the thigh.

exercises.name: Supine straight-leg raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the working knee straight and lift the leg without arching the low back.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the pelvis stacked and lift the top leg without rolling backward.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the feet together and open the top knee without rolling the pelvis.

exercises.name: Standing band hip abduction
exercises.coachingNote: Hold support and move the leg out to the side without leaning.

exercises.name: Mini-band monster walk
exercises.coachingNote: Keep light band tension, take controlled diagonal steps, and keep the knees aligned.

exercises.name: Lateral mini-band walk
exercises.coachingNote: Stay level through the hips and take small side steps without letting the knees cave.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
exercises.coachingNote: Stand tall near support and keep the foot tripod in contact with the floor.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach
exercises.coachingNote: Balance on one leg and reach the free foot in several directions without losing knee alignment.

exercises.name: Treadmill walk
exercises.coachingNote: Walk at a sustainable pace and use incline only if it remains comfortable.

exercises.name: Incline treadmill walk
exercises.coachingNote: Use a modest incline, stay tall, and keep the effort conversational.

exercises.name: Stationary bike
exercises.coachingNote: Choose a comfortable seat height and pedal at an easy-to-moderate effort.

exercises.name: Recumbent bike
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the back supported and pedal smoothly without reaching at the bottom.

exercises.name: Easy air-bike ride
exercises.coachingNote: Use a steady pace that lets you breathe comfortably and maintain smooth arm action.

exercises.name: Easy rowing ergometer
exercises.coachingNote: Drive with the legs, keep the handle path smooth, and use a conversational effort.

exercises.name: Easy elliptical
exercises.coachingNote: Use a smooth stride and keep the effort easy enough to sustain.

exercises.name: Easy stair climber
exercises.coachingNote: Stand tall, use the rails lightly, and keep a steady step rhythm.

exercises.name: Pool walking
exercises.coachingNote: Walk through chest- or waist-deep water at a relaxed steady pace.

exercises.name: Easy continuous swimming
exercises.coachingNote: Use a comfortable stroke and stop before technique or shoulder comfort declines.

exercises.name: Stationary-bike intervals
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the work intervals controlled and recover fully enough to repeat the same output.

exercises.name: Air-bike intervals
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the work bouts strong but repeatable rather than sprinting all-out.

exercises.name: Rowing-machine intervals
exercises.coachingNote: Maintain consistent stroke mechanics during every work interval.

exercises.name: Elliptical intervals
exercises.coachingNote: Increase effort without losing a smooth stride or gripping the handles tightly.

exercises.name: Stair-climber intervals
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso tall and choose a step rate you can repeat consistently.

exercises.name: Tempo run
exercises.coachingNote: Run at a controlled comfortably hard pace that remains steady throughout.

exercises.name: Long easy run
exercises.coachingNote: Stay conversational and keep the pace conservative from the start.

exercises.name: Controlled hill repeats
exercises.coachingNote: Run uphill with controlled power and recover fully while walking down.

exercises.name: Fartlek run
exercises.coachingNote: Alternate relaxed faster segments with easy running while keeping the session controlled.

exercises.name: Recovery jog
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the pace very easy and stop if the run does not feel restorative.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball chest pass
exercises.coachingNote: Throw the ball forcefully from the chest and catch or retrieve it under control.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball overhead throw
exercises.coachingNote: Brace, extend through the hips and arms, and release without overextending the back.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball slam
exercises.coachingNote: Reach tall, brace, and drive the ball down using the trunk and hips.

exercises.name: Rotational medicine-ball wall throw
exercises.coachingNote: Rotate through the hips and trunk together and throw without losing balance.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball shot-put throw
exercises.coachingNote: Load the rear hip and drive the ball forward without letting the shoulder lead alone.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat jump
exercises.coachingNote: Dip into a shallow squat, jump with intent, and land softly before resetting.

exercises.name: Countermovement jump
exercises.coachingNote: Use a quick dip and arm swing, jump vertically, and land in a stable position.

exercises.name: Tuck jump
exercises.coachingNote: Jump vertically, bring the knees up without collapsing the torso, and land softly.

exercises.name: Split jump
exercises.coachingNote: Start in a split stance, jump and switch legs, and land with control.

exercises.name: Lateral bound and stick
exercises.coachingNote: Jump sideways, land on one leg, and hold the landing before the next rep.

exercises.name: Single-leg forward hop and stick
exercises.coachingNote: Hop forward on one leg and hold a quiet stable landing.

exercises.name: Single-leg lateral hop and stick
exercises.coachingNote: Hop sideways and stabilize the landing before repeating.

exercises.name: Depth drop
exercises.coachingNote: Step off a low box, land softly, and hold a balanced athletic position.

exercises.name: Depth jump
exercises.coachingNote: Step off a low box, land briefly, and rebound upward while maintaining alignment.

exercises.name: Low hurdle hop
exercises.coachingNote: Use low hurdles, keep ground contacts quick, and stop if landings become noisy.

exercises.name: Lateral low-hurdle hop
exercises.coachingNote: Hop sideways over a low hurdle and keep each landing controlled.

exercises.name: Short acceleration drill
exercises.coachingNote: Build speed smoothly over a short distance and stop before technique deteriorates.

exercises.name: Flying sprint
exercises.coachingNote: Use a gradual buildup, run the fast zone relaxed, and take full recovery.

exercises.name: Linear deceleration drill
exercises.coachingNote: Build moderate speed and lower the center of mass gradually to stop under control.

exercises.name: 5-10-5 change-of-direction drill
exercises.coachingNote: Stay low into each turn, plant under the body, and prioritize clean direction changes over speed.
